To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated an acousto-optic Q-switched Nd : YVO4 laser with high average output power and high slope-efficiency.

we achieved a maximum output power of 16.9 W at 50 kHz, a slope efficiency of 70%, and a maximum single pulse energy output of 0.9 mJ at 10 kHz, using a LD end-pumped acousto-optically Q-switched 1064 nm Nd:YVO₄ laser with a double-bonded Nd:Y VO₄ crystal scheme.
we achieved high average power,high slope-efficiency and high peak-power acousto-optic Q-switched laser with the LD end-pumped Nd : YVO4 double-bounded scheme.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of the cavity design and the estimation of thermal lens effect in the LD end-pumped acousto-optically Q-switched Nd :YVO_4 lasers.
the development and characterization of a high power acousto-optic Q-switched Nd : YVO4 laser with a laser diodes (LD) end-pumped scheme.
the optimization of the laser parameters and the improvement of the output performance of the acousto-optically Q-switched Nd :YVO4 laser.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results obtained in this paper show that a laser diode end-pumping Nd:YVO _{4} double bonded crystal scheme can be used as an effective and efficient way to generate high average power high slope efficiency high repetition rate high peak power Q-switched laser.
a LD end-pumped Nd : YVO_4 acousto-optic Q-switched laser with a high slope efficiency,high output power and high single pulse energy is achieved.
the laser is capable of producing a maximum of 17.5 W average output power with a slope efficiency of 70% at a repetition rate of 40 kHz.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the high slope efficiency and average output power of the acousto-optic Q-switched laser are obtained by optimizing the cavity parameters and the mode matching under the intense pumping.
the LD end-pumped acousto-optically Q-switched Nd：YVO4 laser with high output power and high efficiency can be achieved with a proper estimation and optimization of thermal effects.
the slope efficiency of 70% and the average output power of more than 10 W at 1 064.3 nm are the highest values reported for LD end-pumped Nd3+:YVO4 acousto-optically Q-switched laser.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the high slope efficiency of the LD end-pumped acousto-optic Q-switched Nd：YVO4 laser is obtained with the proper estimation of the thermal lensing effect.

the thermal lensing effect can be effectively compensated by the thermal stable cavity parameters,and the slope efficiency and output power of the laser can be improved by optimizing the cavity parameters and the pump power density.
we can get a stable high average output power of the acousto-optic Q-switched Nd3+:YVO4 laser by optimizing the mode matching and cavity parameters under the intense pumping.
